utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the carpool this morning?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I’m still on for it this morning. I’ll swing by around the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—thanks. See you at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can help with the carpool. Just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus — I just need help figuring out the pickup times and who’s riding with who.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can help with that. Let’s list the pickup times and match everyone up by route.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool’s still on for tomorrow, but a couple folks are trying to sort out the pickup times. I can check who’s driving if you want.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be great, thanks. I’m mostly worried about the pickup time and whether everyone can fit.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure — I’ll ask around and see if the pickup time’s set and whether we need an extra seat.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What time and days are we looking at?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — we’re aiming for weekday mornings, around 7:45 at my place. I’ll send you the exact days once I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — just send the exact days when you have them, and I’ll plan on 7:45 at your place on weekday mornings.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m putting together the carpool—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’d appreciate a spot if there’s room.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll count you in and let you know the pickup time as soon as I have the route set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure thing, Leo — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What days and times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. I’m thinking weekdays around 8 a.m. and 5 p.m., if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That should work for me, Leo — weekdays around 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. sounds great. I can help coordinate the pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the pickup time and the full list of stops? I want to make sure I’ve got the carpool details right before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — it’s 7:15 at the corner by Maple, then I’m picking up Luis and Priya on the way. If that works, I’ll lock you in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps — I’m good with 7:15 at Maple, but could you confirm the exact order of stops before you lock me in?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can take the carpool on Tuesdays and Thursdays, but I need to be back by 3:15 for pickup. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that works for me — I can handle the other days and make sure we’re back by 3:15 on yours.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thank you — I’ll cover Tuesdays and Thursdays then.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the carpool might still be on, but I’m not sure of the details yet. Have you heard anything more from everyone?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I haven’t heard a full update yet, but I can check in with everyone and see what’s settled. If you want, I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great—I’m still piecing it together from bits and pieces.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m in for carpool—just send me the time and pickup spot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm—what time and pickup spot should I send you?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Anytime after 8:00 works for me, and you can pick me up at my front door.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks Rey — maybe around 7:30, if that works for you?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 7:30 works for me. I can be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’ll repeat the carpool plan to everyone and make sure we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and make sure we’re set for the ride.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep everyone posted on the carpool plan and make sure we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Rey — I heard there might be a change with the carpool. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure yet — I just heard there might be a change, but I’m still waiting to confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the carpool. I’m pretty sure I can do my part, but I should double-check the time so I don’t mix it up again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries—I’ll remind everyone once we lock the time. Just let me know what you find, and I’ll keep the carpool plan straight.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I’ll check and get back to you soon. Appreciate you keeping it straight.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the carpool. I might’ve missed the latest change; what’s the plan?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re still meeting at 7:30 by the curb—just text me if you’re running late.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, 7:30 by the curb. I’ll text you if I’m running late.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I can lend a hand with the carpool if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: I’ll handle the morning run, and if you can take the afternoon pickup, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Eli — I can handle the afternoon pickup. Just let me know the time and I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn, I’m happy to help with the carpool—what time and days are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh thanks, Mara! I was thinking weekdays around 8:00 AM, and maybe we can see which days work best for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Weekdays at 8:00 AM works for me—let’s see who can do which days and I’ll help fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I can help stitch the carpool together—who needs a ride and what times are we working with?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’m still gathering the pickup locations and times, so I’ll send you the full list once I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — send it over when you’ve got it, and I’ll line everyone up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure thing, Cleo — let’s get the carpool sorted out. What days and times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can do weekdays around 8:00 a.m., and I’ll keep an eye on the supplies list too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, that works well — weekdays at 8:00 a.m. sounds like a plan. I’ll line up the route and send you the updated carpool details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m a bit behind—what’s the latest on the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re still on for the usual pickup, but I need to know if you’re in by 5 so I can lock the seats in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, I’m in—thanks for the heads-up. I’ll confirm by 5 so you can lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what time are we leaving?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Let’s leave at 7:30 so we have plenty of time to get there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: 7:30 works for me—I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the carpool. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm if 8:00 works for you?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, 8:00 works for me.
